file_pin_shape: files is an object keyed by repository-relative path; each value is exactly sha256:string64hex, git_blob:string40hex, revision:string40hex. Each revision is a real immutable commit containing the exact file blob.
identity_object_shape: object keyed by retained Git blob40hex; each value contains sha256:string64hex, type:string(blob), size_bytes:integer, exercised_revisions:array of commit40hex strings.
snapshots: Each run retains exact own before/after protected state; cross-session Source/test/helper/contract/feature/phase equal. Immutable state differences are exactly recorded Root dispatch counter/history/timestamp, not mutable current coordination.
scope: Final independent acceptance bundle approval only; Mode B/fresh QA/hosted evidence/Root capture remain mandatory. No authentication, consent, legacy namespace migration or live Root readiness claim.
